text:
Ivy (CS): Need two hands-on enablement sessions for Aurora Therapeutics next week. Customer requests persistent lab state between sessions (sticky lab). Can we support sticky VMs and cap each workshop to 10 attendees?

Dmitri (Enablement): Sticky lab possible but requires reserving dev VMs and provisioning dev keys per participant. Also need an RSVP cap + waitlist to avoid noisy labs. :memo:

Clara (SuccessOps): I can set an RSVP cap and auto-waitlist. Which timezones? APAC-friendly and NA morning preferred. Reminders at 48h and 30m?

Omar (AM): Heads-up: Account marked "high renewal risk". Do not include pricing or contract PDFs in invites. CS will have a separate renewal touchpoint after enablement.

Ivy (CS): Exactly. Add CRM tag enablement_followup=post_session. Also ensure Zoom recording is opt-out and not auto-shared.

Dmitri (Enablement): Proposed schedule:
```
Session A (APAC): Tue 2026-05-05 09:30 AET
Session B (NA): Thu 2026-05-07 10:00 PT
Duration: 75m each (15m setup + 45m guided lab + 15m wrap/Q&A)
Cohort cap: 10; waitlist enabled
```

Clara (SuccessOps): Works for me. I'll configure cap=10, enable waitlist, and add a 2-step RSVP flow (confirm org role + engineering contact).

SchedulerBot: Poll created for timeslots. 14 people invited to vote. (link)

Omar (AM): For sticky labs: can we persist home directory and a pinned API key per participant for 48 hours? I can request the dev keys. Also confirm SSO mapping for Aurora.

Dmitri (Enablement): Yes, stash home dir between sessions for the same user token for 48h. We'll label the snapshot with session_id. Need to limit concurrent heavy experiments. Request SRE on standby if >6 concurrent GPUs.

Ivy (CS): Please include a short prework with smoke-test snippet and required roles. Example prework:
```
1) Ensure org admin or dev role
2) Generate API key in console
3) Run: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>"
```

Clara (SuccessOps): I'll add that to the invite and attach a 1-page checklist. Also adding a 3-question post-session pulse and a brief CS satisfaction metric for renewal scoring. Retain feedback 60 days.

Dmitri (Enablement): Draft invite text below, please check:
"Redwood Enablement — Aurora Therapeutics: hands-on cohorts. Attendance limited to admin+eng. No pricing/contract materials attached. Lab snapshots persisted for 48h for accepted attendees only. Prework required."

Omar (AM): Good. For "high renewal risk" contacts, exclude finance alias and mark in CRM for a separate renewal-runbook call. Do not include them in the follow-up slides.

Ivy (CS): Action items:
- Dmitri: finalize slide deck, lab snapshot plan, post link to prework
- Clara: set RSVP cap=10, enable waitlist, configure reminders & pulse
- Omar: request dev keys & confirm SSO mapping, flag renewal contacts in CRM

Dmitri (Enablement): I'll post calendar invites and the prework doc by EOD tomorrow. Planning to record as opt-out. Will also include a short troubleshooting snippet for 401/429 errors.

SchedulerBot: Calendar invites queued; 22 recipients will receive invitations once poll closes. Waitlist enabled.

Clara (SuccessOps): No blockers. I'll confirm facilitator names and breakout room proctors by tomorrow morning.

Ivy (CS): Thanks team. If poll closes without conflicts I'll close the scheduling loop and tag CRM. :white_check_mark:

SchedulerBot: Poll closed. Final slots confirmed. Invites scheduled to 22 recipients."
